answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring a refundable stake tied to hardware attestation before any agent may trade, like a marble seal stamped at the terrace gate: one verified device, one identity, with the stake slashed on fraud. An attacker must then buy real hardware and lock fresh capital for every fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits, and the profit collapses under that weight, leaving only a faint plume of wasted spend.
